title: Clinic: The Drifting Mean
prompt:
**Bài toán.** n ≤ 200000 integers up to 10^9; print floor(mean) of all
values. (No floating point needed at all.)

**The submission below accumulates a double mean — Wrong Answer on large
inputs due to accumulated precision error.** Fix it with exact integer
arithmetic.

tests.name: small
negative mix
floor check
tests.hint: Mean −3.5 floors to −4 (C++ integer division truncates toward zero — beware!).

tests.name: n=200000
tests.hint: Total 2·10^14: double keeps 2^53 ≈ 9·10^15 so here it agrees — the graded tests include mixes where the last ulp flips the floor. Exact arithmetic is the fix.
